heading.zh-Hant: 洪都拉斯總統任期概略

body.zh-Hant: 達維拉屬自由黨。據《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科全書》條目，他1907至1908年任洪都拉斯臨時總統，其後於1908年當選總統，任至1911年。任內洪都拉斯參加了1907年的華盛頓會議，他也須應付流亡者組織的多次叛亂。1911年，他的政權因博尼利亞重掌權力而告終。
body.en: Dávila was a member of the Liberal Party. According to the Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture, he was provisional president of Honduras in 1907–1908 and then elected president in 1908, serving to 1911. During his term Honduras took part in the 1907 Washington Conference, and he had to deal with numerous rebellions organized by Honduran exiles. His regime ended in 1911 when Bonilla regained power.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、求學與克爾多林事務所
heading.en: Birth, studies and the Kordelin connection

body.zh-Hant: 呂蒂1889年2月3日生於維蒂斯（Vittis）。1906年通過高中畢業考，之後讀法律，取得法學士（licentiat）學位，並在勞馬（Raumo）當律師。1910年夏天，二十一歲的他與芬蘭首富克爾多林（Alfred Kordelin）建立委託關係。1917年11月克爾多林遇害，打斷了他這段事業。
body.en: Ryti was born on 3 February 1889 in Vittis. He passed his studentexamen in 1906, went on to study law, took his juris kandidat (licentiate) degree and worked as a lawyer in Raumo. In summer 1910, at 21, he began a client relationship with Finland's richest man, Alfred Kordelin. Kordelin's murder in November 1917 interrupted that career.

heading.zh-Hant: 議員、財政部長與芬蘭銀行
heading.en: Member of parliament, finance minister and the Bank of Finland

body.zh-Hant: 1919年呂蒂當選議會議員，隨後任法律委員會主席。1921年4月，三十二歲的他在瓦內拉（J. H. Vennola）內閣出任財政部長，之後又在卡利歐（Kyösti Kallio）內閣再任財政部長，但來源明寫他任職不到兩個月，便被任命為芬蘭銀行董事會主席（總裁）。他要到卡利歐內閣1924年1月下台後才就任該職。
body.en: Ryti was elected to parliament in 1919 and soon chaired its legal committee. In April 1921, aged 32, he became finance minister in J. H. Vennola's government and later served a second time in Kyösti Kallio's government, but the source says he was minister there for no more than two months before being appointed chairman of the board (chief director) of the Bank of Finland. He took up that post only after Kallio's government fell in January 1924.

heading.zh-Hant: 莫斯科和約、總統任期與辭職
heading.en: The Moscow peace, the presidency and resignation

body.zh-Hant: 呂蒂在冬季戰爭期間任總理，來源稱1940年3月13日簽署的莫斯科和約可視為他的政治家之舉。1940年12月19日他當選總統，接替因病辭職的卡利歐。1944年夏天他簽署了「里賓特洛甫協定」；其後他簽了辭職書，來源稱真正原因是為了更換國家領導層。1944年8月，議會以特別法選出曼納海姆為總統。
body.en: Ryti was prime minister during the Winter War, and the source regards his signing of the Moscow peace on 13 March 1940 as an act of statesmanship. He was elected president on 19 December 1940 after Kallio resigned through illness. In summer 1944 he signed the so-called Ribbentrop agreement; he then signed a letter of resignation, and the source says the real reason was a wish to replace the state leadership. In August 1944 parliament elected Mannerheim president by a special law.

body.zh-Hant: 其後他再度被任命為芬蘭銀行總裁。1945年夏天他與其他「戰爭責任者」一同被捕，被判十年苦役。1949年4月總統帕西基維（Paasikivi）赦免了他。他的出生與死亡記載為1889年2月3日生於維蒂斯，死於1956年10月25日。
body.en: He was later again appointed chief director of the Bank of Finland. In summer 1945 he was arrested together with other so-called war-responsibility defendants and was sentenced to ten years' hard labour. In April 1949 President Paasikivi pardoned him. He died on 25 October 1956.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、律師與伯恩州政治
heading.en: Origins, legal practice and Bernese politics

body.zh-Hant: 施泰格1881年7月2日生於朗瑙（Langnau im Emmental）。1900至1905年在日內瓦、萊比錫與伯恩修讀法律，1909年起在伯恩自設律師事務所。1914年起他以保守黨身分進入伯恩州大議會，議員任期記為1914至1939年，另在1914至1917年任伯恩市議會議員；1939年他擔任大議會議長。
body.en: Steiger was born on 2 July 1881 in Langnau im Emmental. He studied law in Geneva, Leipzig and Bern in 1900–1905 and ran his own law office in Bern from 1909. From 1914 he sat for the Conservative Party in the Bernese Grand Council (membership recorded as 1914–1939) and in 1914–1917 he belonged to the Bern city council; in 1939 he presided over the Grand Council.

heading.zh-Hant: 州政府、聯邦委員會與晚年
heading.en: Cantonal government, the Federal Council and later life

body.zh-Hant: 1939至1940年施泰格短暫任伯恩州政府委員，主管國民經濟廳。1940年他以第一輪130票當選聯邦委員會委員，接替明格（Rudolf Minger）；1941至1951年主管聯邦司法與警察部，在二戰期間負責國家保衛與庇護政策。1945年與1951年他擔任聯邦主席，1951年卸任，1962年2月10日在伯恩去世。
body.en: In 1939–1940 Steiger briefly served as a Bernese cantonal government councillor, heading the economy directorate. In 1940 he was elected to the Federal Council in the first round with 130 votes, succeeding Rudolf Minger; from 1941 to 1951 he headed the Federal Department of Justice and Police, responsible during the Second World War for state protection and asylum policy. He served as Federal President in 1945 and 1951, resigned in 1951 and died in Bern on 10 February 1962.

body.zh-Hant: 希勒米出生於米蒂利尼島（Midilli）。1902年12月2日他受任為新設的魯米利亞總監察使，在任六年。憲政再度宣布後該總監察使職廢止，他在魯米利亞又留了約三個月，之後因出任卡米勒帕夏內閣內政大臣，於1908年11月27日返回伊斯坦堡。
body.en: Hilmi was born on the island of Midilli (Lesbos). On 2 December 1902 he was appointed to the newly created Inspectorate-General of Rumelia and held it for six years. After the constitution was proclaimed again the post was abolished; he stayed about three more months in Rumelia and then returned to Istanbul on 27 November 1908 on becoming Interior Minister in Kâmil Pasha's cabinet.

heading.zh-Hant: 內政大臣與兩度出任大宰相
heading.en: Interior minister and two terms as Grand Vizier

body.zh-Hant: 1909年2月13至14日，他接替卡米勒帕夏出任大宰相，並保留內政大臣一職。1909年4月13日三月卅一日事件爆發，他在事發首日請辭，首度任期約一個月二十七天。1909年5月5日他再度出任大宰相，歷七個月二十四天，於1909年12月28日被迫辭職。1909年11月14日他獲任貴族院（Âyan Meclisi）議員。
body.en: On 13–14 February 1909 he replaced Kâmil Pasha as Grand Vizier, keeping the Interior Ministry. When the 31 March Incident broke out on 13 April 1909 he submitted the government's resignation on the first day, ending a first term of one month and twenty-seven days. He became Grand Vizier a second time on 5 May 1909; after seven months and twenty-four days he was forced to resign on 28 December 1909. On 14 November 1909 he was appointed to the Senate (Âyan Meclisi).

heading.zh-Hant: 司法大臣、駐維也納大使與去世
heading.en: Justice minister, ambassador in Vienna and death

body.zh-Hant: 1912年7月22日穆赫塔爾帕夏（Gazi Ahmed Muhtar Paşa）組成「大內閣」，希勒米任司法大臣。1912年10月28日他受任為駐維也納大使並離開伊斯坦堡，任職至第一次世界大戰結束、奧斯曼使館廢止為止。停戰後他沒有返回伊斯坦堡，而是留居維也納近郊租來的別墅，1923年4月3日在當地去世。
body.en: On 22 July 1912 Gazi Ahmed Muhtar Pasha formed the "Great Cabinet", in which Hilmi became Minister of Justice. On 28 October 1912 he was appointed ambassador to Vienna and left Istanbul, serving until the Ottoman embassies were abolished at the end of the First World War. After the armistice he did not return to Istanbul but kept living in a rented villa near Vienna, where he died on 3 April 1923.

body.zh-Hant: 菲洛夫（1883–1945）是保加利亞考古學家與政治人物，曾在德國弗萊堡求學。1914年成為索非亞教授，1929年成為保加利亞科學院院士。1938至1940年任教育部長，1940至1943年任保加利亞首相。波里斯三世去世後，他成為保加利亞三人攝政團成員之一。因戰時與德國結盟，他在1944年9月蘇軍入侵後被推翻，由人民法庭處決。
body.en: Filov (1883–1945) was a Bulgarian archaeologist and politician who studied in Freiburg, Germany. He became a professor in Sofia in 1914 and a member of the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences in 1929. He was Minister of Education in 1938–1940 and Prime Minister of Bulgaria from 1940 to 1943. After Boris III died he became one of the three members of the Bulgarian regency. Because of the wartime coalition with Germany he was overthrown in September 1944 after the Soviet invasion and executed by a People's Court.
